name: py_stream_port_regs
desc: AXI4-Lite to AXI-Stream data port: TX FIFO writes, RX FIFO reads, FIFO status, interrupt enables.

registers.name: TXDATA
registers.desc: pushed into the TX FIFO, or dropped with STATUS.TX_OVF set when it is full

registers.name: RXDATA
registers.desc: oldest received word; a read with VALID = 1 removes it from the RX FIFO

fields.name: VALID
fields.desc: 1: a word was read (0: the RX FIFO was empty)

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: FIFO status; write 1 to [2] to clear TX_OVF

registers.name: IRQ_EN
registers.desc: irq_o while an enabled condition holds
